## History

Jem's family, including his parents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), prepared to leave their little house of dreams when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed purchasing the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen). Despite Anne's initial distress over leaving their home, the family eventually celebrated their moving day and departed after saying a tearful final goodbye.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P21](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P65](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0065)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jem.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Little Jem's mother. Jem was born to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) during their time living in their house of dreams at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).
